hero.title: Fragments forged in Truckee. Direct to your body.
hero.sub: Body jewelry forged by hand. No middlemen. No borrowed shelves. Just the piece, the hand that forged it, and your signal.

what_we_are.title: No display case. No middleman.
what_we_are.p1: Wenu Mapu operates 100% online from its workshop in Truckee, California. Every fragment — plug, tunnel, septum, hoop, pendant — is forged, photographed and shipped from the same studio it was born in. There are no intermediaries. There are no borrowed shelves. There is intention and noble material.
what_we_are.p2: The full catalogue lives in this portal. We ship via USPS Priority across the US (2–3 business days). If you're in Truckee, North Lake Tahoe or Reno, you can coordinate local pickup at the studio — free, by appointment.

shop.title: Each piece is an object with presence.
shop.intro: We work organic and noble materials — wood, horn, stone, metal — with craft technique and no industrial repetition. Filter by category or write to us if you're looking for something you don't see here.
shop.not_found: Can't find what you're looking for?

product.shipping_body: USPS Priority Mail. 2–3 business days within the US. Ships within 2 business days of payment confirmation. Discreet packaging, no logos outside.
product.pickup_body: Pickup local (Truckee / North Lake Tahoe): available by appointment. Free. See instructions at
product.returns_note: Body jewelry pieces don't accept returns for hygiene reasons, except for verifiable manufacturing defects. If you receive a defective piece, write to us with photos within 48 hours of delivery.

pickup.title: Pickup in Truckee
pickup.intro: If you're in Truckee, North Lake Tahoe or Reno, you can pick up your order directly at the studio. It's free and we do it by appointment — so the piece is ready and the encounter has time.

1.title: Choose your piece
1.body: Find the piece in the catalogue and select "Local pickup" at checkout. No shipping fee.

2.title: Confirm payment
2.body: Pay online. You'll receive a confirmation email with a link to schedule your slot.

3.title: Pick a time
3.body: Choose the day and time slot available. We respond to all confirmations within 24 hours.

4.title: Come to the workshop
4.body: On the agreed day, you arrive at the indicated point in Truckee. The piece will be ready and packed for you.

5.title: Schedule changes
5.body: If you need to change the time, write to us with at least 12 hours notice via email or Instagram DM.

pickup.note: Pickup is not an open shop — it's a delivery at the workshop. Honor that: you see up close where the pieces come from.
